newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonia bank stocks end up on solid trade.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonia bank stocks end up on solid trade.

text.p: After a slow start, trade on the Estonian stock exchange on Tuesday was solid with local investors positioning themselves for quarterly results due out in early April, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list was 50.1 million kroons and the stock exchange index firmed 1.61 percent to 237.03.
"Trade was moderate with investors securing positions in cheaper stocks for the expected good quarterly results," one dealer said.
Hoiupank saw trade of 15.6 million kroons to close on 120.50 kroons, a gain of 3.00 kroons.
"Hoiupank was at a good price and the buying pressure was there for the day," another dealer said.
Uhispank was 1.15 kroons higher to finish on 49.00 kroons with a turnover of 15.1 million kroons.
Tallinna Farma turned over 5.6 million kroons and picked up 1.25 kroons for a close of 120.00 kroons.
Hansapank was slow today with 3.7 million kroons of shares traded and its price inched up 3.90 kroons to finish at 239.90 kroons.
"There were some block trades late in the day which gave the price a push, but the stock was dull for most of the day with little interest," one trader said.
On the free market, trade remained slow with only 4.2 million kroons of shares changing hands.
Tallinna Kaubamaja was the most active stock with 1.6 million kroons of shares traded as it edged upwards by 0.85 kroons to 85.25 kroons.
Rakvere meat plant lost 0.15 kroons to close on 14.25 kroons after seeing trade of 1.4 million kroons.
